newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Fergie named Vienna Opera Ball guest of honour.
newsitem.headline: Fergie named Vienna Opera Ball guest of honour.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York, Sarah Ferguson, will be the guest of honour of Austrian building magnate Richard Lugner at the historic Opera Ball in Vienna on February 6, Lugner told Reuters on Thursday.

Lugner, whose search for a companion for the ball each year stirs up a flurry of speculation in Austrian media, has in the past been accompanied by actresses Sophia Loren, Bo Derek, and singer Grace Jones.
Lugner, who was reported to have paid one million schillings ($87,000) for the pleasure of Loren's company, declined to say how much he may have paid Ferguson. ($1=11.53 Schilling)
